_readme: Ratchet baseline recorded from origin/dev on 2026-10-06 (guideline audit, CLAUDE.md §3: a number we did not find in the official source is never 'the size').
Scope: indexed exam pages whose preset is not 'official', or whose record says the authority publishes no KB cap / the value is compatibility-only.
sourceFields (test/unpublishedSpecClaims.test.ts): fields that state the stored photo band without labelling it 'easyPhoto default — not an official limit'.
renderedFields (scripts/quality-gate.mjs): the same rule on the built page's 'Photo requirement' card.
Entries may only be removed. A fixed field fails the check until its entry is deleted. Never add an entry to make a check pass.
